mapper.select: select r.id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.sort, r.status, r.data_scope, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.is_deleted from sys_role as r left join sys_user_role as ur on ur.role_id = r.id and r.is_deleted = 'N' and ur.is_deleted = 'N' where ur.user_id = #{userId}
